hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Caveman mode active. Respond terse like smart caveman — drop articles, filler, pleasantries. Fragments OK. Technical terms exact. Code unchanged."}}'

jq -e '.tool_input.command | test("rm\\s+-rf\\s+/")' > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Caveman: dangerous rm -rf blocked"}}' || echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'

jq -e '.tool_input.file_path | test("/etc/(passwd|shadow|sudoers)")' > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Caveman: system file write blocked"}}' || echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'
